sbhot.summary: A mobile heated self-service buffet counter with a lit canopy and granite servery top, holding four 1/1 gastronorm pans. It suits canteens, hotels and function rooms needing a castor-mounted hot food display; the SBHOT 4 is the 1550 mm model.

highlights.text: Rosa Parino granite servery top with lit canopy and wood-effect finish.
Castors fitted; capacity for 4 x 1/1 gastronorm pans (sold separately).

sbhot.notes: Source is the SBHOT 4 page (1550 wide), matching Caterkwik's dimensions; SBHOT 6 is 2200 wide. Temperature range as printed looks odd; no wattage, voltage or weight on the page read, so Caterkwik's 1.25 kW / 220V are unverified. Product is discontinued.

sources.title: Seal Counter-top Heated Food Display Showcase SCH785 - Lincat

sch785.summary: A Lincat Seal countertop heated showcase with thermostatic control, digital display and a humidity feature to stop food drying out. The SCH785 is 785 mm wide and takes 2 1/1 gastronorm containers, for cafes, delis and counters displaying hot food.

highlights.text: Fully adjustable precise thermostatic control with digital display.
Humidity feature prevents food drying out; minimum food holding temperature 72 C.

facts.label: Water / drain
facts.value: No water line or drain required; drip pan not included

sch785.notes: Lincat lists 53 kg product weight (ship weight 58.3 kg); Caterkwik states 72 kg, which looks wrong. Spec sheet, manual and CAD files exist on the Lincat page but their URLs were not captured. Only one source read.
